continuity: The Unnamed Sword is the Fire Gate Clan’s sacred treasure, and Jeok Cheongang entrusted it to Jin Taekyung.
Jeok Cheongang publicly threatens to destroy the Zhongnan Sect and Mount Zhongnan if Song Il or the Zhongnan Sect harms Jin Taekyung or the Jin Family of Taiyuan.
Song Il leaves the Jin Family humiliated and injured, then orders the Three Hands of Zhongnan to return to Zhongnan after Jeok’s warning.
Gong Ilhyuk incited Song Il to confront the Jin Family; Song Il later renders Gong Ilhyuk and the other two members of the Three Hands unconscious.
plot: Jeok Cheongang reveals that the Unnamed Sword is the Fire Gate Clan’s sacred treasure and publicly confirms that he entrusted it to Jin Taekyung. Taekyung realizes that Jopil stole the sword from Jeok Cheongang and that Cheongpung’s earlier speculation about Jeok taking him as a Disciple may not have been nonsense.

After forcing Song Il to swear that he will not pursue the Jin Family over the incident, Jeok Cheongang follows the departing Zhongnan group. Song Il incapacitates Gong Ilhyuk and the other two members of the Three Hands in anger, but Jeok breaks Song’s wrist, strikes him with the Flame Divine Palm, and threatens to destroy the Zhongnan Sect and Mount Zhongnan if Taekyung or the Jin Family is harmed. Song Il abandons his threat and orders the Three Hands to return to Zhongnan.
translation_decisions: Render 열화문의 신물 as “Fire Gate Clan’s sacred treasure”; this refers to the Unnamed Sword.
Retain “Tongue King” for 혀왕, Taekyung’s joking nickname for Jeok Cheongang’s verbal intimidation.

active_continuity: The Unnamed Sword is the Fire Gate Clan’s sacred treasure, and Jeok Cheongang entrusted it to Jin Taekyung; this secret is now public before the Jin Family and Zhongnan visitors.
Jeok Cheongang publicly threatened to destroy the Zhongnan Sect and Mount Zhongnan if Song Il or the Zhongnan Sect harms Taekyung or the Jin Family.
Song Il left the Jin Family humiliated and injured, ordered the Three Hands of Zhongnan to return to Zhongnan, and abandoned his threat after Jeok’s warning.
Gong Ilhyuk incited Song Il to confront the Jin Family and was rendered unconscious by Song Il along with the other two members of the Three Hands.
Three Dark Heaven remnants survived interrogation under powerful restrictions, and Wipeng was ordered to keep them alive as the Jin Family’s only physical evidence.
Jin Wikyung suspects Dark Heaven’s attack on Shanxi Province was only the beginning and considers the Jin Family’s victory suspiciously easy.
Lee Seowol and the Mount Heng Sword Sect swore loyalty to the Jin Family of Taiyuan on New Year’s Day, and the Jin Family accepted the sect as its vassal.
Chulwoo is twenty-five, has fallen intensely in love with Lee Seowol, and lost his challenge to Taekyung after seeing him interact with Seowol.
Taekyung is a Peak Master with Sound Transmission access, current Strength above 300, Level 73, and seventy allocated stat points; he completed the duel Quest and won the Jin Family tournament event.
Cheongpung says Taekyung’s victory relied on extraordinary speed and that Taekyung read and countered Crouching Tiger Fist after two days.
Baek Museong apologized to Jin Wikyung for his earlier rudeness and acknowledged learning from Taekyung and Chulwoo’s duel.
The Zhongnan Sect visitors at the Jin Family included Song Il, Gong Ilhyuk, Hyuk Mujin, and two unidentified men.
Song Il is an Elder of the Zhongnan Sect, the Roaring Fury Swordsman, and the senior brother of Sect Leader Gong Iljung.

Song Il came to demand redress for Gong Ilhyuk’s injury and the alleged insult to Zhongnan, attacked Taekyung with the Heavenly River Thirty-Six Swords, and was stopped and humiliated by Jeok Cheongang.
Jeok Cheongang and Song Il met when Song was barely twenty; Jeok once saved Song at his Master’s request, and Song later accused Jeok of stealing his battle credit.
Jeok Cheongang is the Fire King, whose presence and voice demonstrate Supreme Peak power; he entrusted the Fire Gate Clan’s sacred treasure to Taekyung.
Jeok Cheongang rescued Jangcheon during an Anhui epidemic, accepted him as his Disciple, and later learned that Jangcheon became Jopil.
Jang Taebo agreed to forge Taekyung’s Ten-Thousand-Year Cold Iron into a spear, but the work is not yet complete.
The Treasured Jade remains missing, and Jopil’s possession or loss of it has not been resolved.
Woo Hwangtae’s conflict with Chulwoo and the Jin Family remains unresolved.
open_questions: What is Dark Heaven ultimately seeking, and why was Shanxi Province targeted?
Who are the three surviving Dark Heaven remnants, and what can be learned from them?
Does Jeok Cheongang intend to take Jin Taekyung as his Disciple?
When will Jang Taebo complete Taekyung’s commissioned weapon?
Who has the Treasured Jade, or was it lost by Jopil?
What consequences will follow Woo Hwangtae’s conflict with Chulwoo and the Jin Family?
Will Song Il honor his pledge after returning to Zhongnan, and what consequences will follow his confrontation with the Jin Family?
How will the public revelation of Taekyung’s entrusted Fire Gate Clan treasure affect the Jin Family?

profile_updates.current: - **Role:** Nearly one-hundred-year-old wandering martial master and the Fire King; he visits Jang Taebo’s home, can detect Qi Sense, can cross more than ten jang in an instant, plans to reach Taiyuan and visit the Lower District Sect while concealing his identity, and once fought Sword Saint Mae Jonghak for seven days and seven nights to a draw at Mount Jiuhua before emerging from seclusion and annihilating one thousand Demonic Cultists there; after striking Jin Taekyung with the Flame Divine Palm, he deduces that Taekyung took the Blazing Flame Divine Pill and confronts him when he tries to flee the inn; he reaches the Jin Family of Taiyuan, uses Six-Harmonies Voice Transmission to stop Song Il, publicly humiliates him, and reveals that he entrusted the Fire Gate Clan’s sacred treasure to Taekyung.
